notes.title: 2025/09/11 Update - Backpack Logic Optimization
notes.content: Backpack equipment can be shared by all characters simultaneously

notes.title: Major Update — Summoner & Spirit Weapons
notes.content: [h1][b]Update Details[/b][/h1][h2]1.[b]New Character: Summoner[/b][/h2][p]The Summoner’s weapons and skills interact with the new Spirit Weapons. She also comes with high innate Magic Penetration, making her a powerful addition to your Endless Challenge runs.[/p][h2]2.[b]New Weapon Type: Spirits[/b][/h2][p]A new type of weapon that automatically attacks enemies. Some spirits can synergize effectively with your commonly used weapons.[/p][h2]3.[b]New Treasures[/b][/h2][p]Added new treasures related to spirits, which can enhance spirit attributes or improve character stats.[/p][h2]4.[b]New Skills[/b][/h2][p]Added two new penetration skills (one physical, one magical).[/p][h2]5.[b]New Illustrations[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164370/80ce6d8f0b6053f3753888d9fb64f9d73b6974a9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164370/6a14d3d7abe784ec6811769553949e8a98023f69.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164370/35ea42e0fd17df0ae720be7c3d10815b0aa35d0b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164370/c8304e63becac9ca9fe8f1606f8122cff8fa84b7.png"][/img][/p][p]Each character now has multiple additional illustrations, unlocked after completing their respective Endless Challenge.[/p][h2]6.[b]Other Changes[/b][/h2][p]Each character now has their own equipment slot, allowing more suitable archive equipment to be assigned per character.[/p][p]Refresh will no longer show already offered options.[/p][p]Enemies and elite monsters in Endless Mode have been strengthened and are no longer trivial.[/p][p]Performance optimizations in Endless Mode – significantly reduced risk of game freezes.[/p][p]Meteorfire weapon special effects enhanced – the bonus stat provided after obtaining a new weapon has been changed from Attack/Magic Power to Attack Coefficient/Magic Coefficient.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/08/08 Update
notes.content:
-Fixed mismatch between unique affix text and effects on saved equipment
-Fixed issue where some affixes on saved equipment weren't working

notes.title: Update 2025/08/06
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where Lightning weapons could not be obtained.
-Attempted to optimize lag caused by high-frequency damage instances.

notes.title: 2025/08/03 Update
notes.content:
-Fixed some text issues.
-Optimized the logic for the Black Tornado's smaller tornadoes.
-Added Range to the enhancement pool for all weapons (can be enhanced up to twice the base value).
-Removed the attribute cap for most weapons.
-Increased the damage coefficient effect for War Spear.
-Enhanced the base damage boost effect for some weapons.
-Increased the EXP gained from Wind Slash.

notes.title: 2025/08/02 Update
notes.content:
-Modified some text and special effects
-Limited the base movement speed of BOSS
-Restricted weapon duration time
-Fixed bugs caused by the Occult Bond system
-Capped weapon stat maximums

notes.title: Update 2025/08/01
notes.content:
-Partial text modifications
-Adjusted BOSS level cap
-Modified ESC key logic
-Optimized some BOSS mechanics
-Fixed issues caused by disabling auto-loot

notes.title: 2025/07/30 Update
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue where the appearance and names of some token quest NPCs did not match.
-Added a new feature to fully clear Endless Mode.
-Added two new token quests.
-Adjusted weapon enhancement values.
-Full HP will now be restored upon entering bonus stages.
-Increased the initial advancement probability.
-Improved advancement probability modifiers related to tokens.

notes.title: 2025/07/29 Update
notes.content: Disabled gold and EXP gain after 10 minutes

notes.title: 2025/07/28 Update 2
notes.content:
-Initial guidance now only appears in Difficulty 1
-Attempted to fix the endless mode crash issue
-Fixed incorrect appearances for some relic NPCs

notes.title: 2025/07/28 Update:
notes.content:
- Modified some attribute descriptions (all attribute reductions are now considered negative effects)
- Enhanced certain artifacts
- Fixed an issue where unlocking new skills caused level swapping between new and existing skills

notes.title: 2025/07/27 Update 3
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue where some equipment effects in saves were not working
-Added an "Equipped" tag to the save inventory
-Fixed incorrect requirements for relic quests
-Fixed the issue where transparency settings had no effect

notes.title: 2025/07/27 Update 2
notes.content:
-Unlocked various attribute rewards in bonus stages (now gaining money, EXP, and attributes even after 10 minutes)  
-Modified some texts

notes.title: 2025/07/27 Update
notes.content:
Wizard's Basic Weapon - Fire Lightning Enhanced
-Initial size doubled
-All effects boosted
Fixed an issue where token quests couldn't be completed
Reduced attribute requirements for some token quests
Lightning - Thunder Spear size doubled

notes.title: 2025/07/26 Update 2
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the Endless difficulty rating wouldn't progress
All rewards can still be obtained after 10 minutes
Optimized text in the reward stage equipment selection interface
Arcane - Meteor Fire [Damage Bonus] effect enhanced: Now grants additional attributes based on acquisition count

notes.title: 2025/07/26 Update
notes.content:
Fixed button response issues in the in-game settings interface
Disabled box-opening animation by default
Attempted optimization to reduce lag or freezing in endless mode
Most interfaces can now be exited by pressing ESC in-game
Enhanced initial weapons for missile characters
Modified missile behavior logic
Token updates
-Added two new skills
-Fixed an issue with incorrect mission difficulty

notes.title: Update Notes – 2025/07/24
notes.content:
Merchant icon now shows a countdown timer

Token missions can now be completed on higher difficulties of the corresponding map

Improved UI responsiveness for certain interactions

Reduced chest opening time by 30%

Weakened the damage of the Spider Boss

notes.title: 2025/07/24 Update Notes
notes.content:
The game now supports Traditional Chinese!

You can switch languages via [Settings] > [Language].
